description: Use this when the signed-in owner asks what's planned or booked this week: each post's day, time, platforms and where it stands (waiting for approval, approved, scheduled, posted, failed, cancelled), in their own timezone, plus any Story or extra platform it's booked on. A quick list without pictures; to see the posts themselves use get_my_posts. Read only.
name: get_my_week
title: Show my week
